meta.notes: NI 43-101 FS report-reconciliation fixture in real 2024 USD. Table 22-2 reports every annual line rounded to the nearest US$1m. Payable quantities are mathematically derived from each metal's reported annual revenue divided by the fixed report price; this preserves the independently reported metal revenue rows without a balancing item. Initial/expansion CAPEX share the schema's non-sustaining capex series. The final-year net closure line is uniquely decomposed from Table 22-1 totals as US$137m closure less US$62m salvage.

runtimeProxyRule.label: 7.5% EBITDA mining-tax runtime proxy
runtimeProxyRule.notes: Runtime proxy captures the disclosed 7.5% earnings basis. For the report leg the annual mining-tax row is included in taxCashFlowUSD so the engine's pre-tax reconciliation adds back all taxes, matching Table 22-2's pre-tax definition.

reportLockedItems.notes: Report leg is zero here to avoid double counting; the exact rounded annual mining-tax cash series is combined with income tax in reportTaxCashFlowUSD.

taxModel.notes: REPORT: Table 22-2's rounded annual Special Mining Tax plus Income Tax rows, combined so pre-tax reconciliation adds back all taxes exactly as the report defines pre-tax cash flow. RUNTIME: disclosed 30% federal income tax with loss carryforward; the separate 7.5% mining-tax runtime proxy remains in fiscalTakeModel. The opening US$51.3m tax pool and detailed depreciation schedules are not guessed into runtime.

report.periodsPageOrTable: Table 22-2 pp.508-510 (columns Y-2, Y-1, Y1...Y20 mapped to relative t=0...21)
report.assumptionsNotes: 100% project basis, real USD with no escalation, two construction years, 19.2-year production life, mid-period discounting to construction start, constant Ag/Au/Pb/Zn prices, 0.5% government NSR, 7.5% special mining tax, 30% income tax, and all products sold in the year produced. reportInitialCapexUSD is the schema-compatible total of US$606m initial plus US$309m expansion capital (Table 22-1; rounded annual row totals US$914m). Annual values are rounded to US$1m. No working-capital line is reported or residual-implied.

reportedCostCheckpoints.definitionNotes: Total cash cost: site operating cash costs plus transportation, royalties, treatment and refining charges.
